title: きらきら星 (Kirakira Boshi — Twinkle Twinkle Little Star)
description: The Japanese version of 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star,' known in Japan as きらきら星. The twinkling stars blink and watch over everyone from high in the night sky. The melody is universally familiar, and the simple vocabulary — きらきら (twinkling), ひかる (to shine), おそら (the sky) — makes it a perfect first song for absolute beginners.
license: Public Domain (Original melody 'Ah! vous dirai-je, Maman' c.1761; Japanese adaptation is a traditional educational song)
